name: Bear Plank
steps: Start on all fours with your hands directly beneath your shoulders, knees directly beneath your hips, and toes tucked under.
Press your hands firmly into the floor, brace your core, and keep your spine long and neutral.
Lift your knees just clear of the floor, keeping your shins parallel to it.
Hold steadily while breathing smoothly for the target duration, then lower your knees gently to finish.
tips: Keep your knees hovering just above the floor rather than hiking your hips upward.
Push the floor away through your hands so your upper back stays broad and stable.
